verdict.rationale: Greptile lets customers control where their data lives only by self-hosting. It deploys via Docker Compose or Kubernetes on AWS, GCP, Azure, on-prem or air-gapped environments, runs inside the customer's VPC, and in self-hosted mode logs are stored on customer servers only. Nothing shows a region or residency choice for the hosted cloud service, so residency control requires running your own infrastructure. missing for 10: region/data-residency selection (e.g., EU/US) for the hosted SaaS, documented residency guarantees for cloud customers, independent corroboration.
